Визначили порядок подальших кроків. Сьогодні будуть формалізовані рішення щодо заміни керівництва Збройних Сил України – відповідні укази готуються. Разом із Михайлом Драпатим та Євгенієм Хмарою визначили, що новим начальником Генерального штабу Збройних Сил України стане генерал-майор Ігор Скибюк – дуже досвідчений військовий, із яким новий Головнокомандувач пліч-о-пліч захищав Україну. Важливо, щоб усі складові нашої армії і надалі функціонували абсолютно злагоджено. Так само разом визначили, як в подальшому Олександр Сирський та Андрій Гнатов служитимуть захисту нашої держави. Обговорили, які організаційні рішення мають бути реалізовані. Зокрема, це стосується розвитку українських кіберсил, підготовки воїнів і посилення можливостей наших підрозділів, розвитку корпусної системи. Відзначено, що пріоритет для реальної здатності Збройних Сил України виконувати оборонні завдання – це практичний, ефективний процес мобілізації. Подякував Силам оборони України за виконання плану далекобійних санкцій проти Росії, а також за ритмічність у виконанні мідстрайків. Євгеній Хмара займається вирішенням тих питань щодо постачання для дипстрайків та мідстрайків, які обговорювалися цими днями з бойовими командирами та виробниками зброї. Проаналізували поточну ситуацію і виконання наших оборонних завдань на Олександрівському напрямку, на Донеччині та інших напрямках інтенсивних бойових дій. Дякую всім українським підрозділам за силу й повноцінну реалізацію відповідних операцій. Визначили кроки, рішення та призначення посадовців, які мають прискорити реалізацію ключових ініціатив у сфері захисту неба – наша антибалістична програма «Фрея», робота зі Сполученими Штатами щодо ліцензій на виробництво «петріотів», а також співпраця з нашими європейськими партнерами щодо визначених спільних програм. Дякую Олександру Сирському та Андрію Гнатову! Бажаю Михайлу Драпатому та Ігорю Скибюку бойової удачі, перемог для України та успіху в ураженнях російських окупантів! Слава ЗСУ! Слава Україні!

We determined the sequence of the next steps. Today, the decisions on the changes in the leadership of the Armed Forces of Ukraine will be formalized – the relevant decrees are in preparation. Together with Mykhailo Drapatyi and Yevhenii Khmara, we determined that Major General Ihor Skybiuk will become the new Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Ukraine. He is a highly experienced officer who defended Ukraine shoulder to shoulder with the new Commander-in-Chief. It is important that all components of our Armed Forces continue to function in complete coordination. We also determined together how Oleksandr Syrskyi and Andrii Hnatov will continue serving in the defense of our country. We discussed the organizational decisions that need to be implemented, including the development of Ukraine's cyber forces, the training of our warriors, strengthening the capabilities of our units, and further developing the corps system. A practical, effective mobilization process was identified as a priority for ensuring the Armed Forces of Ukraine have the real ability to carry out their defense missions. I thanked Ukraine's Defense Forces for delivering on our plan of long-range sanctions against Russia, as well as for their consistency in executing our mid-strikes. Yevhenii Khmara is addressing the supply issues related to deep strikes and mid-strikes that were discussed over the past few days with combat commanders and weapons manufacturers. We reviewed the current situation and the implementation of our defense objectives in the Oleksandrivka direction, in the Donetsk region, and in other areas of intense fighting. I thank all Ukrainian units for their strength and for the successful execution of these operations. We determined the steps, decisions, and appointments that should accelerate the implementation of key initiatives to strengthen our air defense – our FREYJA anti-ballistic program, our work with the United States on licenses to produce Patriots, as well as our cooperation with European partners on the agreed joint programs. I thank Oleksandr Syrskyi and Andrii Hnatov! I wish Mykhailo Drapatyi and Ihor Skybiuk good luck in battle, victories for Ukraine, and success in striking the Russian occupiers! Glory to the Armed Forces of Ukraine! Glory to Ukraine!

Сьогодні було успішне ураження далекобійними санкціями України важливих цілей у Краснодарському та Ставропольському регіонах – логістичних центрів, що задіяні у забезпеченні російської армії комплектуючими для дронів, навігаційного обладнання та спорядженнями, а також ураження чергової нафтобази. В акваторіях Чорного й Азовського морів уражено танкер і чотири суховантажі російського тіньового флоту. Дякуємо всім нашим воїнам Сил оборони України за ці результати. Цілком справедливо повертаємо війну додому – в Росію. Мир потрібен, і Україна дала російській стороні всі пропозиції. Треба примусити перейти до дипломатії. Слава Україні!

दिल्ली में जारी विरोध-प्रदर्शन गंभीर चिंता का विषय हैं। यह अत्यंत दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण है कि हमारे देश के छात्रों और युवाओं को कुछ लोग अपने राजनीतिक स्वार्थों की पूर्ति के लिए एक राजनीतिक औज़ार के रूप में इस्तेमाल करने का प्रयास कर रहे हैं। प्रधानमंत्री श्री @narendramodi के नेतृत्व में हमारी सरकार विद्यार्थियों और युवाओं की आकांक्षाओं को पूरा करने और उनके कल्याण के प्रति पूरी तरह प्रतिबद्ध है। हमारे छात्रों की हर चिंता को सुनना और उसका समाधान करना हमारी जिम्मेदारी है।मुझे पूर्ण विश्वास है कि भारत के जागरूक, परिपक्व और विवेकशील युवा ऐसे भ्रामक प्रयासों को भली-भांति समझते हैं और वे प्रगति, विकास तथा राष्ट्रनिर्माण के मार्ग को ही चुनेंगे। हम इस बात के लिए प्रतिबद्ध हैं कि किसी भी व्यक्ति, विशेषकर हमारे छात्रों और युवाओं के साथ किसी भी प्रकार का अन्याय न हो। विपक्ष के कुछ नेताओं द्वारा Manufactured Sense of Anger केवल जनता, विशेषकर हमारे बच्चों और युवाओं को भ्रमित करने और गुमराह करने का एक असफल प्रयास है। युवाओं की भावनाओं और उनकी चिंताओं के प्रति हम पूरी तरह संवेदनशील हैं। संसद का सत्र चल रहा है, सरकार ने हर मुद्दे पर सार्थक बहस करने की भी बात कही है, मगर विपक्ष संसद में नहीं बल्कि सड़क पर मुद्दों का समाधान करने का अनुचित प्रयास कर रहा है। लोकतंत्र में मुद्दों पर चर्चा करने की जगह संसद भवन है, जहाँ विपक्ष अपनी बात कहने के लिए स्वतंत्र है। इसलिए यदि विपक्ष गंभीर है तो मौजूदा मानसून सत्र को सुचारु रूप से चलाने में व्यवधान न उत्पन्न करे और संसद में ही सभी मुद्दों पर देश का ध्यान आकर्षित करे। Video

Today we celebrate the birthday of Gustav Hertz, co-recipient of the 1925 @NobelPrize in Physics for the discovery of the laws governing the impact of an electron upon an atom. While working at the University of Berlin in the early 1910s, Hertz performed experiments with his colleague James Franck in which they directed electrons of different energy levels through a gas enclosed in an electron tube. Through this ‘Franck-Hertz experiment’, as it came to be known, they verified for the first time the quantum nature of atoms, meaning that energy can be absorbed by an atom only in definite amounts. This conclusion proved to be consistent with Niels Bohr’s theory on the structure of the atom.

For 59 years, ASEAN’s journey has been shaped by milestones of dialogue, cooperation, and community-building across Southeast Asia Guided by the theme of ASEAN’s 2026 Chairship, “Navigating Our Future, Together,” we look back at the moments that have brought the region closer. As we count down to ASEAN Day, let us celebrate the milestones that have shaped ASEAN’s shared journey and continue to guide the region towards a more resilient, connected, and hopeful future. #59thASEANDay #ASEAN59 #NavigatingOurFutureTogether

Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, on 22 July 2026, delivered pre-recorded remarks at the 2nd Plenary Session of the 17th AIPA Caucus, held under the theme "Strengthening ASEAN Centrality in Navigating Complex Global Challenges." In his remarks, SG Dr. Kao reaffirmed the important role of parliamentary collaboration in advancing common legislative initiatives and in promoting greater harmonisation of laws across ASEAN Member States in support of ASEAN Community-building efforts. Dr. Kao further emphasised that stronger synergy between ASEAN's intergovernmental processes and national parliaments is essential to translate regional commitments into domestic action, strengthen the implementation of regional collective aspirations, while ensuring a robust ASEAN Centrality, so that the benefits of ASEAN integration are enjoyed by its people. Watch the full remarks: youtu.be/DPpnPfCJScU

Secretary-General of ASEAN, Dr. Kao Kim Hourn, today held a bilateral meeting with Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Türkiye, H.E. Berris Ekinci, on the sidelines of the 59th ASEAN Foreign Ministers’ Meeting (AMM) and Related Meetings in Manila, the Philippines. They discussed ways to enhance ASEAN-Türkiye cooperation in areas of mutual interest in line with the ASEAN-Türkiye Sectoral Dialogue Partnership: Practical Cooperation Areas (2024-2028) and explored avenues to further strengthen the formal partnership in the lead‑up to its 10th anniversary of the ASEAN-Türkiye formal relations in 2027. Both sides also exchanged views on the Treaty of Amity and Cooperation in Southeast Asia (TAC), taking note of its 50th anniversary this year and recalling that Türkiye acceded to the TAC in 2010.

Deputy Prime Minister/Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar @MIshaqDar50 held a productive meeting today with ADB Vice President (South, Central and West Asia) Mr. Yingming Yang, ADB Vice President (Sectors and Themes) Ms. Fatima Yasmin, ADB Director Generals and officials, along with Executive Director for Pakistan, Ms. Nashita Mohsin, at the Asian Development Bank Headquarters in Manila. The two sides reaffirmed their more than six-decade-long Pakistan–ADB partnership and explored ways to further strengthen cooperation in infrastructure, climate resilience, regional connectivity, and sustainable economic growth. The DPM/FM appreciated ADB’s steadfast support for Pakistan’s development priorities and underscored the importance of continued collaboration. The Deputy Prime Minister highlighted the Main Line-1 (ML-1) railway project as one of the Government’s flagship infrastructure initiatives and a priority of Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif @CMShehbaz. He emphasized ADB’s continued support in leading the consortium lending for this project and requested an expedited processing timeline. The ADB Vice Presidents reaffirmed the Bank’s commitment to working closely with Pakistan to advance the project, recognizing its transformative role in modernizing Pakistan’s railway network, strengthening connectivity, and supporting sustainable economic growth. Special Assistant to the Prime Minister (SAPM) Tariq Bajwa, Pakistan’s Ambassador to the Philippines Dr. Asima Rabbani, and senior officials from both sides also attended the meeting.

Deputy Prime Minister/Foreign Minister Senator Mohammad Ishaq Dar @MIshaqDar50 visited the Headquarters of the Asian Development Bank (ADB) in Manila today, where he was received by the Director General for the Central and West Asia Department, Ms. Leah Gutierrez. He signed the ADB Visitors’ Book upon arrival. DPM/FM was later hosted at a working lunch by Pakistan’s Executive Director to the ADB, Ms. Nashita Mohsin, with a group of Pakistani professionals serving in senior leadership positions across the ADB. The interaction provided an opportunity to exchange views on the ADB’s evolving development agenda, its partnership with Pakistan, and the important role being played by Pakistani professionals in advancing the Bank’s work across a broad range of sectors and regions. DPM/FM appreciated their valuable contributions to the ADB’s mission and acknowledged the distinction they bring to Pakistan through their leadership and expertise at the institution. DPM/FM also congratulated Ms. Nashita Mohsin on assuming her responsibilities as Pakistan’s Executive Director to the ADB and wished her success in advancing Pakistan’s engagement with the ADB.

Trump Gives Green Light to Saudi Nuclear Program The Donald Trump administration has finalized the draft of a bilateral nuclear agreement that authorizes Saudi Arabia to enrich uranium on its own territory. Although the negotiating teams have completed the terms, the document still awaits Trump’s final signature and approval by the U.S. Congress. This framework breaks with the region’s long-standing non-proliferation rules. Unlike the deal with the United Arab Emirates, which permanently renounced uranium enrichment and plutonium reprocessing while accepting strict IAEA inspections, the agreement with the Saudis does not require Riyadh to adopt the Agency’s inspection regime. Oversight will be limited to a bilateral pact between the United States and Saudi Arabia. This reinforces what Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman has already said openly: if Iran gets a nuclear weapon, Saudi Arabia will want one too. It sounds like a clear signal that Riyadh believes Tehran already has, or is very close to having, the bomb, which explains the intense pressure they are putting on Washington. The situation puts the U.S. in a complicated position. Saudi Arabia’s ballistic missile program is developed in partnership with China, complete with technology transfers. If the Americans don’t give in now, the Saudis have plenty of money to look for other partners. This is not just about civilian nuclear energy. For that, it would be enough to buy reactors and import ready-made fuel. What Riyadh really wants is to master the full nuclear fuel cycle, especially domestic uranium enrichment. With this infrastructure, Saudi Arabia is building a nuclear latency capability: it will control the core technology needed to develop a weapon in relatively short order if pushed by an existential threat. According to the allegations, the attack was carried out under the direct instruction of former Home Minister and BNP leader Altaf Hossain Chowdhury. His brother Shahin Chowdhury, along with Palash Halder, Monir Khandakar, Sumon Talukdar Tunu, and Mohasin Member, are accused of leading the operation. The victims further allege that Miraj, a candidate for the Chhatra Dal presidency, personally supervised the removal of household belongings, with five vans reportedly transporting valuables, including refrigerators and furniture. They also claim that the attackers broke open wardrobes and looted approximately 17 bhori of gold jewelry, along with important family documents and other valuables. After the looting, the remaining structure was allegedly set on fire. The victims argue that the incident represents a grave example of politically motivated violence carried out under the cover of administrative inaction. ২০২৬ বিশ্বকাপের ফাইনাল হারের পর চোখে জল আর ভবিষ্যৎ নিয়ে অনিশ্চয়তার বার্তা দিয়েছিলেন আর্জেন্টিনার কোচ লিওনেল স্ক্যালোনি। এবার নিজের শহর পুজাতোতে ফেরার আগে সেই দৃশ্যের পুনরাবৃত্তি দেখা যায়নি। মুখে প্রশস্ত হাসি নিয়ে তিনি শুধু দল ও সমর্থকদের প্রশংসাই করেননি, বরং স্পেনের বিপক্ষে ফাইনাল ঘিরে ছড়িয়ে পড়া বিতর্ক ও নানা ষড়যন্ত্র তত্ত্বকেও সম্পূর্ণ গুরুত্বহীন বলে উড়িয়ে দিয়েছেন। সাম্প্রতিক সময়ে সামাজিক মাধ্যমে মেসির অনুপ্রেরণামূলক বক্তব্য (পেপ টক) এবং দলের পারফরম্যান্স নিয়ে ছড়িয়ে পড়া নানা তত্ত্ব সম্পর্কে জানতে চাইলে স্ক্যলোনি স্পষ্ট ভাষায় বলেন, 'আমি সামাজিক মাধ্যম দেখি না। এসব সম্পর্কে কিছুই জানি না। আপনারা কী বলছেন, আমার কোনো ধারণাই নেই।' উত্তর দেয়ার সময় তার ভাষা ছিল মার্জিত, কিন্তু এমন দৃঢ় যে তিনি শুরুতেই সব ধরনের বিতর্কের ইতি টানতে চেয়েছেন। তবে দলের মধ্যে কোনো বিভাজন বা অভ্যন্তরীণ দ্বন্দ্ব আছে কি না, এমন প্রশ্নে তিনি গাড়ি থেকে নেমে বলেন, 'আপনারা আমাকে কী প্রশ্ন করছেন, আমি বিশ্বাসই করতে পারছি না। আপনারা সম্পূর্ণ ভিন্ন দিকে চলে যাচ্ছেন।' এরপর তিনি খেলোয়াড়দের মানসিকতার প্রশংসা করে যোগ করেন, 'সবচেয়ে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ বিষয় হলো, ছেলেরা নিজেদের সর্বস্ব উজাড় করে দিয়েছে। এই জার্সির জন্য তারা দৃঢ়তার পরিচয় দিয়েছে, আমাদের সেটাই দেখা উচিত। আশা করি আগামীকাল যখন কোনো খেলোয়াড় জাতীয় দলে আসবে, তখন এসব বিষয় গুরুত্ব পাবে না। এটাই হওয়া উচিত।' এজেইজা বিমানবন্দরে জাতীয় দলকে যে বিশাল সংবর্ধনা দেওয়া হয়, তা নিয়েও আবেগ প্রকাশ করেন স্ক্যালোনি। দলের বাসে লাফিয়ে-চিৎকার করে উদযাপন করা এই কোচ বলেন, 'অভ্যর্থনাটা ছিল অবিশ্বাস্য। হার মেনে নেওয়া অবশ্যই কঠিন। আমরা জয়ের মানসিকতা নিয়ে চলি। তবে হারতে শেখাও গুরুত্বপূর্ণ। পরাজয় থেকেও ইতিবাচক কিছু শেখা যায়।' বিশ্বকাপের পর স্বাভাবিকভাবেই স্ক্যালোনি, মেসি এবং এমি মার্টিনেজের ভবিষ্যৎ নিয়ে প্রশ্ন ওঠছে। মার্টিনেজের আবেগঘন পোস্টও নতুন জল্পনার জন্ম দিয়েছে। নিজের ভবিষ্যৎ প্রসঙ্গে স্ক্যালোনি বলেন, 'আমরা ডিসেম্বর পর্যন্ত আছি। সবচেয়ে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ বিষয় হলো, সবকিছু যেভাবে ঘটেছে। মানুষ বুঝেছে দল তাদের সর্বস্ব দিয়েছে। এরপর যা-ই হোক, সবচেয়ে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ সবসময় আর্জেন্টিনা। আমি থাকি বা না থাকি, এই ঐক্যটাই সবচেয়ে বড় বিষয়। আমি মনে করি, আমরা কখনও সেই সংযোগ হারাইনি।' ২০২৭ সালেও তিনি দায়িত্বে থাকবেন কি না, এমন প্রশ্ন আবারও করা হলে হেসে জবাব দেন, 'আবার সেই একই প্রশ্ন, তাই তো?' এরপর আগের সংবাদ সম্মেলনের বক্তব্যের পুনরাবৃত্তি করে তিনি বলেন, 'সত্যি বলতে, এখন সবচেয়ে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ বিষয় এটিই। এটা আমার স্বপ্ন পূরণ। জীবনে কখনও ভাবিনি প্রথম কোচিংয়ের অভিজ্ঞতাই হবে আর্জেন্টিনা জাতীয় দল। এর আগে কোথাও কোচিং করাইনি। তারা আমাকে সুযোগ দিয়েছিল, আর এরপর আমরা যা অর্জন করেছি, তা স্বপ্নের মতো। পৃথিবীর যেকোনো কোচই এমন জায়গায় থাকতে চাইবে।' #FIFAWorldCup2026 #WorldCup #Football #SomoyTV

Subsea cables carry 95% of all intercontinental digital communications, underpin USD 10 trillion in daily financial transactions, and are formally designated critical communications infrastructure by the United Nations. India, despite consuming 20% of intercontinental internet traffic, hosts only 3% of global subsea cables, concentrates most of them at a single coastal location, and has no domestic repair vessels whatsoever. In this Discussion Document, Anwesha Sen (@Anwxsha) maps the structural vulnerabilities of India's subsea cable ecosystem and lays out a five-cluster policy roadmap covering CNI designation, concentration risk reduction, sovereign repair capability, investment attraction, and underwater domain awareness. The 44th GCPP cohort came together in Bangalore for three intense days of policy simulation, debate, and democracy in action! In the midst of trying to solve one of India's foremost tech policy problems, they also visited Ati Robotics for a fantastic tour of the facility and an insight into India's robotics industry! The Advanced Public Policy cohort attempted policy solutions to an equally thorny problem in the public health area: building antimicrobial resilience. From regulation to incentives, they worked on what it takes to contain a slow-moving crisis before it becomes a full-blown emergency. To top off the experience, playing Nagara provided the much-needed lighthearted break after hours of intense policy debate! Strip an industrial robot to its bones and you find seven technologies. India has most of them in hand — the castings, the controller, the software. The one it lacks is a strange gear called the harmonic drive, which lets the arm bend with perfect repeatability, and which a handful of makers — mostly Japanese — supply to the entire planet. That single gap keeps the whole machine imported. IndiaBUILD, a new Swarajya project, exists to map exactly these gaps — all of them. WHAT IT IS A living wiki of the hard technology India imports but could build. 18 sectors. 2,500+ capabilities mapped. 4,000+ sourced claims — growing daily. Every capability graded on an honest six-step ladder, from none to competitive — and built-under-licence sits on a lower rung than owned-design. Every claim tied to a checked source: AI-researched, machine-verified, human-published. HOW IT THINKS Products sit on trees of capabilities — a robot arm on seven, a jet on hundreds. Dependencies are drawn as edges: master one part and you unlock many machines (one precision ballscrew feeds CNC tools, robots and chip fabs alike). Builders are tracked with their claimed stage and our assessed stage, side by side. Statuses carry dates, so the map records movement. ALREADY ON THE MAP Why every MRI in India runs on 100% imported liquid helium. The three materials that decide chip sovereignty — polishing slurry, substrate film, photoresist — none made here. The Ukrainian plant that supplied Indian train wheels, until the war stopped it in 2022. The solar chain: modules assembled at world scale, every wafer beneath them imported. You cannot build what you have not named. The map names 2,500. Each name has a page, and each page shows its sources. Explore the most detailed public map of India's technology gaps ever assembled — indiabuild.wiki/

در بررسی سیر جنبش‌های بنیادگرایی گفته می‌شود که آن‌ها واکنشی به استعمار، جنگ، فساد، فروپاشی دولت و تحقیر تاریخی هستند. این سخن ممکن است گاهی درست باشد، اما پرسش این است که چرا همیشه مسلمانان مورد استعمار و اشغال دیگران قرار می‌گیرند؟ درست است که جنبش‌های اسلام‌گرا در خلاء پدید نیامده‌اند و فقر، اشغال و بی‌عدالتی در ظهور آن‌ها سهم داشته است، اما کدام منطق می‌گوید که علت پیدایش یک جنبش، رفتار آن را نیز توجیه می‌کند؟ تجربه‌ی ما نشان می‌دهد جنبش‌هایی که از دل ظلم برخاسته‌اند، پس از رسیدن به قدرت، خود به نیرویی از شرارت بی‌همتا تبدیل شده‌اند. آن‌ها ممکن است قربانی بوده باشند، اما قربانی‌بودن به‌خودی‌خود کسی را عادل نمی‌سازد. باید دید آن جنبش با انسانی که زیر سلطه‌اش قرار می‌گیرد، چه می‌کند؟ تاریخ جنبش‌ها را بررسی کنید؛ در کجای تاریخ توانسته‌اند به رنج انسان‌ها پایان دهند؟ در کجای تاریخ توانسته‌اند حتا شرور نباشند؟ ریشه‌ی بسیاری از رفتارهای بنیادگرایانه را می‌توان در ترس از انتخاب دید. انتخاب یعنی پذیرفتن این‌که فقط یک راه برای زندگی وجود ندارد. ممکن است یک زن خانه‌دار باشد و زن دیگری داکتر شود. ممکن است یک جوان زندگی مذهبی را برگزیند و دیگری برداشت متفاوتی داشته باشد. حتا دو انسان مؤمن نیز ممکن است از یک مسأله فهم یکسانی نداشته باشند. اما بنیادگرایی این تفاوت‌ها را برنمی‌تابد. از تخصصی‌ترین وزارت‌ها و ریاست‌ها، مانند وزارت صحت، مخابرات، تکنولوژی، اقتصاد و معادن گرفته، تا وزارت خارجه، باید بی‌تفاوت به تخصص، ملا باشد و پشتون باشد؛ وزارت خارجه، با دانش تخصصی روابط بین‌الملل، باید با لنگی و لباس ژولیده‌ی برادران یوسف کنعان اداره شود. بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/257755

A wide ranging discussion with Politburo member and Foreign Minister Wang Yi of China in Manila #Philippines. Text of my opening remarks as below: Excellency, I am glad to meet you again. Our participation in the EAM and the ASEAN Regional Forum not only provides an occasion to exchange views collectively, but also hold this bilateral meeting. We ourselves met a year ago and you were recently in India. Today's occasion will be useful in taking stock of our ties and also discuss important regional and global developments. Since the meeting of our leaders in Kazan in October 2024, relations between India and China have been gradually normalizing. This direction was further affirmed when they met in Tianjin last August. We believe that a stable and cooperative relationship can best be developed on the basis of mutual respect, mutual interest and mutual sensitivity. Such a relationship can make a valuable contribution to a multi-polar Asia and a multi-polar world. Peace and tranquility in the border areas is obviously the pre-requisite for normal ties. Since October 2024, both sides have engaged to ensure that important objective. This will continue to need our constant attention. Relevant mechanisms in this domain must be given full support and strong encouragement. It is natural that as two large and important nations, and that too proximate neighbours, India and China would have their own particular interests. That is why our leaders had agreed that differences should not become disputes. It is the responsibility of diplomacy to properly manage them. Excellency, the steps in normalization taken over the last few months must be welcomed. This includes resumption of direct flights, updating of the visa regime, restarting the Kailash Manasarovar Yatra, and re-commencing border trade. However, there are also important dimensions of our ties that need to be addressed. Fair market access and a trade balance ranks high in that regard. There are also concerns about predictability of supply chains. Facilitating both official and people-to-people exchanges merit our attention. We also need to agree on the meetings of various mechanisms and platforms as per our mutual priorities. India is the chair of the BRICS this year. Let me take the opportunity to appreciate the support that China has given to various BRICS activities and initiatives during our chairship. The global situation is currently extremely complicated. Meeting at an international gathering, it would be appropriate to exchange views on some of its pressing aspects. Once again, I am glad to see you and look forward to our discussions.

Shijian-31: a satellite with an orbit we have never seen before China launched Shijian-31 on June 16 from Xichang, officially described as a "space environment detection" mission. The orbital elements suggest more going on. The inclination 63.46° sits at the value where perigee advance goes to zero. Anyone who's tracked Molniya-class satellites will recognize that immediately. But the resemblance stops there. A classic Molniya parks its apogee over high northern latitudes and dwells for hours, that's the whole design premise. SJ-31's argument of perigee is 171°, which puts perigee near the equator and its apogee on the opposite side. (Image 1: SJ-31 at 171° argument of perigee vs. a generic Molniya at 270° argument of perigee.) So the long dwell isn't over any particular latitude — it's over altitude. Apogee reaches ~39,900 km, about 4,100 km above the operational GEO belt where comms and missile-warning satellites sit. Nearly a third of each 12.5-hour orbit is spent above that shell, crossing it twice per pass at a steep 63° angle. (Video 1: SJ-31's orbit visualized with example GEO assets.) It's also not fixed on one region. The period is just off a clean repeating ground track, so the sub-apogee point slowly drifts around the globe — sweeping past every longitude roughly once every 24 days. Net effect: an orbit that periodically looks down on the entire GEO belt from above, at an angle, on a rotating schedule, rather than fixating on one target. A two-day brainstorming workshop on Naval Stealth-Beyond 2030 was organized by NSTL, Visakhapatnam, during 20–21 July 2026, bringing together key stakeholders from DRDO, Indian Navy, Defence Shipyards and Industry to deliberate on future directions in naval stealth technologies. The workshop was inaugurated by Dr. R V Hara Prasad, DG(NS&M) on 20th July in the presence of R Adm Sujit Baxi, DG WDB, and Director, NSTL. During the workshop, NSTL handed over Technology for Fabrication, Installation & Commissioning of the LM2500 Gas Turbine Infrared Suppression System for Naval Vessel to BHEL Over 125 delegates representing DRDO Laboratories, Indian Navy, Defence Shipyards, and Industry attended the workshop. New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani says the city does not have the legal authority to arrest Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and cannot enforce the arrest warrant issued by the International Criminal Court (ICC). Mamdani, who had previously pledged during his election campaign to arrest Netanyahu, said his administration had reviewed all available legal avenues to determine whether New York City could enforce the ICC warrant. However, he said the authority to execute the warrant rests with the U.S. federal government. He also called on Washington to enforce the ICC arrest warrant if Netanyahu travels to New York. Netanyahu is expected to visit New York in September to attend the United Nations General Assembly. #TOLOnews_English

In Jingxian county, Anhui province — the birthplace of xuan paper — the China Xuan Paper Museum offers an immersive journey into one of China's oldest artistic traditions. Renowned for its smooth texture, remarkable durability, and ability to preserve artworks for centuries, xuan paper has long been the preferred medium for Chinese painting and calligraphy. Inspired by layered sheets of xuan paper, the museum's distinctive architecture incorporates local architectural elements and blends beautifully with the surrounding paper-drying yards. Inside, discover the centuries-old papermaking process, admire rare historic paper, priceless collections, and masterpieces of Chinese painting and calligraphy, and gain a deeper appreciation of the craftsmanship that has shaped Chinese art for over a thousand years. chinabound.cn Travel with ease in China, and with meaning. #ChinaXuanPaperMuseum #XuanPaper #Anhui #ChinaBound #ASnapshotOfChina

New Policy Brief | Fiscal Implications of Geopolitical Disruptions for India's Fertiliser Sector For decades, India's fertiliser subsidy regime has shielded farmers from volatility in global fertiliser and energy markets. But by insulating domestic prices from international movements, it also transmits sharp increases in global fertiliser, feedstock, and energy prices straight into higher subsidy expenditure. The disruption of the Strait of Hormuz in late February 2026, the principal maritime corridor for India's imports of urea, DAP, LNG, ammonia, and sulphur has brought this vulnerability into sharp focus. Assessing three scenarios for FY27, Ritika Juneja, Sachchida Nand, Emil Thomas Johny, and Ashok Gulati estimate that the fertiliser subsidy, budgeted at INR 1.71 trillion, could rise to between INR 2.42 and 3.32 trillion, or about 0.6–0.8% of GDP. The brief argues the crisis is less a temporary supply disruption than a stress test of India's fertiliser policy, exposing heavy import dependence, the continued price control of urea, distortions in the Nutrient-Based Subsidy framework, and the absence of strategic reserves. It proposes a reform agenda spanning gradual decontrol of urea through a farmer-centric DBT mechanism, rationalisation of the NBS framework, diversification of import sources and feedstocks, strategic fertiliser reserves, and investment in green ammonia, arguing that fertiliser security must be treated as a strategic national priority. 🚨 President Donald Trump says Pickaxe Mountain is next. "We're going to take out Pickaxe Mountain. Tell the Iranians to be ready." Pickaxe Mountain is Iran's deepest and most heavily fortified suspected nuclear facility, buried roughly 80-100 meters beneath granite near Natanz. It was built after the 2020 sabotage of the Natanz centrifuge complex as a hardened fallback site. Neutralizing it would likely require multiple B-2 Spirit bombers dropping sequential GBU-57 Massive Ordnance Penetrators in coordinated waves, alongside electronic warfare, suppression of Iranian air defenses, real-time ISR, and repeated strikes on tunnel entrances, ventilation shafts, and supporting infrastructure. Even then, military analysts assess the mountain may be too deep for conventional bunker-busters to fully destroy, making access denial and operational paralysis a more realistic objective than complete destruction.

Congratulations to Major General Mykhailo Drapatyi on his appointment as Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces of Ukraine. This is a breath of fresh air and a new source of hope in the fight of free people for freedom and justice. It is the voice of change that could no longer be ignored. Now, the high expectations of the Ukrainian people must be met with a clear vision for bringing the War of Independence to a successful conclusion, a strong team and decisive action focused on saving the lives of our service members, accelerating the robotization of the battlefield, delivering asymmetric strikes and exhausting Russia’s economy. I also called General Oleksandr Syrskyi to thank him for the defense of the Kyiv region, the Kharkiv counteroffensive and other historic battles. These achievements are already an important part of Ukraine’s history. But now we must move even faster, write the next chapters of that history and correct the mistakes of the past. Thank you to everyone who made this possible.

Well, the ability to unite in a dark hour, take matters into our own hands, go out into the streets, and speak out against those in power has more than once saved our people when they stood on the brink of destruction. Today, the fact that Ukraine remains a democracy despite everything has finally placed its best and most decent battlefield general, Mykhailo Drapatyi, at the head of its armed forces in this terrible war—a man supported almost unanimously by both the people and the army. This is a great victory, one of the very many hard-won steps toward the light amid the darkness that have already been taken, with many more still ahead. Today, the entire free world has something to celebrate.

It was a privilege to co-chair the incredible 34th Australian American Leadership Dialogue—my family for more than two decades and always the best, driven by the inspirational Julie Singer Scanlan and former Speaker Tony Smith. An amazing few days among very special Australian and American friends and colleagues. The United States and Australia have everything to gain from a vastly enhanced alliance. And despite some differences, as well as defense strategies that are closely aligned but by no means identical, they have moved affirmatively over the last fifteen years toward broader and more multilayered partnerships with each other and third parties not just in the security domain but on critical minerals, supply chains, and research and development on emerging and foundational technologies, spurred in part by @the_AALD combining innovators, creatives, and the talents of people from diverse professional backgrounds and experiences to fashion solutions to an ever widening set of technological, security, and economic challenges. In this 75th anniversary year of ANZUS and 250th birthday year of the United States, what is needed to ensure an alliance fit for purpose is ambition combined with empathy—and social license from the public to meet the increasingly challenging realities the two countries face. An incredibly unique, special, and important forum.

We had guessed reward seeking might increase over the course of capabilities-focused RL training, but had no way of measuring it until now. We’re continuing to collaborate with Apollo Research to improve how reward-seeking is measured during training—and better detect whether models are doing the right thing for the right reason.
Contrastive SDF gives copies of the same model opposing beliefs about what the grader prefers, then measures how their behavior changes.

Reward hacking asks: did the model exploit the reward? Reward-seeking asks: was grader approval what motivated the model’s choice? The second is potentially more important for generalization, because behavior can change when beliefs about the grader change.

What can four decades of land cover data reveal? A changing landscape. The latest release of the Annual National Land Cover Database (NLCD) extends annual mapping through 2025, providing a longer view of how landscapes across the United States have changed over time. One example is the Great Salt Lake in Utah. In the mid-1980s, the lake’s water levels reached historic highs. Since then, water levels have fluctuated over the years but have declined overall. Built from Landsat imagery, Annual NLCD maps land cover across the United States each year, helping researchers, government agencies, businesses, and communities better understand how landscapes are changing. Learn more about the latest Annual NLCD release, including how to access and download the data: 👉ow.ly/yPls50ZqOWp 🎥: Animation showing Annual NLCD maps of the Great Salt Lake area in Utah (1985 to 2025). Darker blue represents open water, while lighter blues represent wetlands. Shades of green signify various types of forests. Shades of red represent developed areas, including cities and roads, with darker shades indicating more intense development. Light tan is grassland; darker tan is shrub/scrub land cover; yellow is pasture/hay; and brown is cropland. Gray is barren land. Video

Scientists in the Philippines have discovered a remarkable plant with a superpower: it can thrive in heavily polluted soil by sucking up toxic heavy metals without being harmed. The plant, named Rinorea niccolifera, was identified by researchers from the University of the Philippines Los Baños on Luzon Island. It belongs to a rare group of species known as hyperaccumulators. This hardy plant can absorb and store up to 18,000 parts per million of nickel in its leaves. 100 to 1,000 times more than typical plants can tolerate. It also effectively pulls cadmium and lead from the soil, safely storing the toxins in its tissues. The discovery highlights the potential of phytoremediation, an eco-friendly, low-cost technique that uses plants to naturally clean up contaminated land. Researchers believe Rinorea niccolifera could become a powerful tool for restoring ecosystems damaged by mining and industrial pollution.

आज नेता प्रतिपक्ष राहुल गांधी ने जिस प्रकार का कृत्य किया है, वह न केवल अशोभनीय है, बल्कि लोकतांत्रिक मर्यादाओं के भी विपरीत और अत्यंत निंदनीय है। नेता प्रतिपक्ष जिस गरिमा का पद है, उस पद को भी राहुल गांधी गंभीरता से नहीं लेते हैं, ये उनके व्यवहार में साफ दिखाई दिया। लोकतंत्र में विरोध करना प्रत्येक विपक्ष का अधिकार है, लेकिन विरोध और अराजकता में स्पष्ट अंतर होता है। जब विरोध अपनी मर्यादा की सीमाओं को लांघ देता है, तब वह अराजकता का रूप ले लेता है। हम लगातार कहते आए हैं कि राहुल गांधी आज रचनात्मक विपक्ष की बजाय अराजकता के प्रतीक बन कर रह गए हैं। संसदीय लोकतंत्र में कुछ पद ऐसे होते हैं, जो किसी एक दल के नहीं, बल्कि पूरे राष्ट्र के होते हैं। प्रधानमंत्री केवल किसी राजनीतिक दल के नेता नहीं, बल्कि 140 करोड़ देशवासियों द्वारा चुने गए जनप्रतिनिधि हैं। वे देश की जनता की आस्था, विश्वास और लोकतांत्रिक व्यवस्था के सर्वोच्च प्रतीकों में से एक हैं। ऐसे में प्रधानमंत्री आवास की ओर जिस प्रकार से माहौल को तनावपूर्ण और अव्यवस्थित बनाने का प्रयास किया गया, वह केवल राजनीतिक विरोध नहीं, बल्कि लोकतांत्रिक संस्थाओं और परंपराओं के प्रति असम्मान का परिचायक है। आज की घटना निश्चित रूप से दुर्भाग्यपूर्ण है। भारत के राजनीतिक इतिहास का एक काला दिन है। हमने भी वर्षों तक विपक्ष में रहकर अपनी भूमिका निभाई है, लेकिन कभी लोकतांत्रिक मर्यादाओं और संसदीय परंपराओं का उल्लंघन नहीं किया। जिन मुद्दों को लेकर हमारे छात्र विषय रख रहे हैं, सरकार उस पर चर्चा करना चाहती है। राहुल गांधी ने स्वयं जो शर्तें रखीं, सरकार ने उन्हें भी स्वीकार किया। लेकिन जब संवाद और समाधान का अवसर आया, तो वे अपनी ही शर्तों और अपने ही रुख से पीछे हट गए। यह उनके राजनीतिक आचरण में अस्थिरता और अपरिपक्वता को स्पष्ट रूप से उजागर करता है। - श्री @NitinNabin Video

New Policy Brief | One Year of U.S. Tariffs: Shifts in India's Export Patterns FY 2025-26 marked the first full year of India–U.S. trade under the reciprocal tariff regime introduced on April 2, 2025 through Executive Order 14257, the most far-reaching U.S. tariff action in nearly a century. India was initially subjected to a 26% reciprocal tariff under a regime that saw several revisions over the year, measures made all the more consequential by India's overdependence on the U.S. market for its exports. With full-year trade data now released by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, @NishaTaneja20, Sanjana Joshi, Vasudha Upreti, Pratik Tiwary, and Yashika Khatri trace the evolution of the tariff measures, assess India's dependence on the U.S. market, examine how exports performed across markets, and evaluate the extent to which affected exports were absorbed elsewhere. Their brief reviews the Government of India's response, from longstanding diversification policies to the renewed push that followed the tariff episode, and sets out recommendations to deepen market diversification and strengthen resilience against market-specific policy shocks. Nietzsche said a lot of contradictory stuff but one of his most consistent ideas is that archaic western culture used to value brute strength for its own sake but Judeo-Christianity inverted the relationship between strength and goodness and encouraged the strong to feel guilt and pity for the weak. He revered Homer's Odysseus much more than a contemporary Christian priest. So it's funny that Nolan made The Odyssey kinda Christian—accentuating the main character's guilt, trauma—and then many Christian conservatives, who decided that they were going to hate the movie because it had a Black actress in the wrong role, instead have to twist themselves into the pretzel of arguing that making the Odyssey Christian is "woke" and they just really wanted to see a movie and hero that properly embodied the very same archaic and anti-Christian values that in any other context they would consider abhorrent. Matt Walsh (@MattWalshBlog) Just saw The Odyssey. Despite what you may have heard, literally all of the criticisms by conservatives were entirely correct. The movie is just as woke as you fear, if not more so. The DEI casting is atrocious. Completely takes you out of the story right from the beginning. But even worse than that is Nolan’s decision to turn Odysseus into an anachronistic whiney, solemn shell of a man plagued by “trauma” and guilt. It’s impossible to overlook these flaws because the film itself is not terribly entertaining or well constructed. For the most part it is disjointed, dull, self-serious, disenchanted, somehow feeling both verbose and overly rushed at the same time. The dialogue is some of the worst I’ve ever heard in a “critically acclaimed” film. “On the nose” and “clunky” are descriptions that can’t even begin to describe this script. At no point in the story does Nolan ever transport the audience to the ancient world. You never feel like you’re 3,000 years in the past. You feel like you’re watching modern Americans put on a pageant, because you are. Nobody would be calling this thing a masterpiece if it was made by a director not named Christopher Nolan. — http://nitter.perennialte.ch/MattWalshBlog/status/2079385765402833029#m

प्राइवेट नौकरी वालों को भी पेंशन का तोहफा, EPFO 3.0 में सरकार बना रही रिटायरमेंट का मास्टर प्लान EPFO Pension Scheme: 60 साल के बाद पेंशन आर्थिक सुरक्षा देती है. सरकारी नौकरीपेशा लोगों को रिटारमेंट के बाद हर महीने एक निश्चित रकम पेंशन के तौर पर मिलती है,ये सुविधा प्राइवेट नौकरी करने वालों को नहीं मिल पाती है. EPFO अब पेंशन से जुड़े बड़े बदलाव की तैयारी कर रहा है. EPFO एक ऐसी यूनिवर्सल पेंशन योजना पर काम कर रही है, जिसमें प्राइवेट कर्मचारी, गिग वर्कर, फ्रीलांसर, छोटे कारोबार से जुड़े लोग भी पेंशन योजना का लाभ पा सकेंगे. अगर ऐसा होता है, तो सरकारी कर्मचारियों के साथ-साथ करोड़ों लोगों को सोशल सिक्योरिटी मिल जाएगी. हालांकि अभी इस प्रस्ताव पर विचार ही किया जा रहा है, आधिकारिक तौर पर इसकी जानकारी सामने नहीं आई है. . . सरकार EPFO 3.0 के तहत देश की सामाजिक सुरक्षा व्यवस्था में बड़ा बदलाव करने की तैयारी कर रही है, जिसमें संगठित क्षेत्र के अलावा गिग वर्कर्स, प्लेटफॉर्म वर्कर्स, सेल्फ इम्प्लॉय लोगों तक पेंशन की सुरक्षा पहुंच सकेगी. नई कंट्रीब्यूटरी पेंशन स्कीम में लोगों को लंबे समय तक सरकारी स्कीम में निवेश करना होगा, जिसपर सालाना ब्याज भी मिलेगा . 60 साल की उम्र में स्कीम को TRS यानी Target Retirment Sum में बदलने की सुविधा होगी. आपको रिटारमेंट के समय कितना फंड चाहिए, इसके आधार पर आप हर महीने, सालाना ईपीएफओ में बचत करेंगे. आप अनुमानित पेंशन, सेविंग, रिटायरमेंट फंड जैसी तमाम डिटेल को अपने डिजिटल डैशबोर्ड पर देख सकेंगे. रिटारमेंट के बाद पेंशन पाने के लिए आपको दो विकल्प मिलेंगे. आप अपनी जमा रकम को Annuity Plan या Systematic Withdrawal Plan चुन सकेंगे. एन्युएटी प्लान में हर महीने आपको तय पेंशन मिलेगा. जबकि SWP प्लान के तहत आप अपनी जरूरत के मुताबिक अपने रिटायरमेंट फंड से पैसा निकाल सकेंगे. इस योजना की सबसे बड़ी खासियत है कि इसमें सिर्फ कर्मचारी या कंपनी नहीं, बल्कि गिग वर्कर्स, CSR फंड, NGO, श्रमिक सब जुड़ सकेंगे. नई योजना NPS स्कीम से अलग होगी. नेशनल पेंशन सिस्टम में रिटायरमेंट के बाद आपको एकमुश्त रकम एन्युटी में मिल जाती है. जबकि ईपीएफओ की नई स्कीम में अंशधारक के पास यह चुनने का विकल्प होगा कि वो जमा रकम को एक साथ लेना चाहता है या ब्याज की रकम को हर महीने पेंशन के तौर पर लेना चाहता है , जहां मूल रकम सुरक्षित जमा रहेगी या समय-समय पर अपनी जरूरत के हिसाब से निकालना चाहता है. #EPFO #Pension #PrivateJobs

Hunger has declined for a third consecutive year. That is welcome progress and proof that coordinated action and investment can make a difference. However, #SOFI2026 also warns that progress remains fragile. Nearly 2.7 billion people may still be unable to afford a healthy diet. Affordability is a whole-value-chain issue. It depends on resilient production, affordable inputs, effective storage and processing, functioning markets and decent incomes for small-scale producers. Climate shocks, conflict, inflation and disruptions to energy, transport and trade affect this chain. That is why integrated investment in production, value chains and market systems is so important. The evidence shows this works. IFAD-supported projects increased participants’ incomes, production and market access by at least 34 per cent. Where strong private-sector engagement was included, income gains reached 64 per cent. @IFAD's focus on nutrition is cross cutting. We approach nutrition as a food systems outcome integrated across our investments. Scaling up investment in resilient food systems and value chains that connect rural producers to opportunity and consumers to affordable and nutritious food. SOFI 2026 gives us the evidence. Mr. Eskandar Momeni, Interior Minister of the Islamic Republic of Iran, who is on an official visit to Pakistan, called on Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif at the Prime Minister House, earlier today. During the meeting, the Prime Minister welcomed the Iranian Interior Minister and his delegation to Pakistan. While recalling his visit to Tehran, earlier this month, to attend the funeral ceremony of the late Supreme Leader Ayatollah Sayyid Ali Khamenei, the Prime Minister conveyed his respectful regards and good wishes for Supreme Leader His Eminence Sayyid Mojtaba Hosseini Khamenei and President Dr. Masoud Pezeshkian. While emphasizing that Pakistan would continue to play its role as an honest and sincere mediator and facilitator, the Prime Minister reiterated Pakistan’s strong commitment to regional peace and stability. Interior Minister Eskandar Momeni thanked the Prime Minister for the warm welcome accorded to him and his delegation in Islamabad. He conveyed greetings and best wishes of the Iranian leadership. He stated that he was leading a delegation of senior government officials to enhance bilateral ties. The Iranian Minister expressed deep appreciation for the Prime Minister, Deputy Prime Minister Ishaq Dar and Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir for their untiring mediation efforts that led to the Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding. Shri Vivek Aggarwal, Secretary, Ministry of Culture, visited the Humayun Museum at Sunder Nursery, New Delhi, today and took a walkthrough of the world-class exhibitions showcased there. During the visit, he explored “One Mother, Many Mother Tongues,” an exhibition presented through a collaboration between the Ministry of Culture, Government of India, and the Government of Italy, as well as “Sanskriti: Every Art, Indian Textiles,” curated by the Indira Gandhi National Centre for the Arts (@ignca_delhi) in collaboration with the Aga Khan Trust for Culture. Mr. Luis Monreal, Head of the Aga Khan Trust for Culture (Worldwide), accompanied the Secretary during the walkthrough. Officials from the Archaeological Survey of India (@ASIGoI), IGNCA, and the Aga Khan Trust for Culture were also present on the occasion. #CultureUnitesAll

On the instructions of Chief Minister Smt. Rekha Gupta, District Level Coordination Committees have been constituted across all 13 districts of Delhi to strengthen coordination among departments and ensure a swift, unified response to waterlogging during the monsoon. By closely monitoring preparedness, vulnerable locations, drain maintenance and emergency measures, these committees will enable timely action on the ground. For the people of Delhi, this means smoother mobility, reduced inconvenience during the monsoon and uninterrupted delivery of essential civic services.

मुख्यमंत्री श्रीमती रेखा गुप्ता ने दिल्ली के लाल डोरा एवं आबादी क्षेत्रों में संचालित स्वामित्व योजना की प्रगति की समीक्षा की। ▸ योजना के तहत 48 गांवों को शामिल किया गया है। इनमें से अब तक 30 गांवों का ड्रोन सर्वेक्षण पूरा हो चुका है और उनके अंतिम प्रॉपर्टी कार्ड तैयार हैं। ▸ अब तक 12,232 संपत्तियों का सर्वेक्षण किया जा चुका है। इनमें 8,423 विवाद-मुक्त संपत्तियों के लिए क्यूआर कोड युक्त स्मार्ट पीवीसी प्रॉपर्टी कार्ड जारी करने की प्रक्रिया अंतिम चरण में है। ▸ डिजिटल संपत्ति अभिलेख तैयार किए जा रहे हैं तथा रिकॉर्ड को DORIS से जोड़ने की प्रक्रिया भी जारी है। स्वामित्व योजना से दिल्ली के ग्रामीणों को उनकी संपत्तियों का प्रमाणिक डिजिटल रिकॉर्ड मिलेगा। इससे वर्षों से चली आ रही समस्याओं का समाधान होगा और संपत्ति संबंधी सेवाएं अधिक सरल, तेज और पारदर्शी बनेंगी।

केंद्रीय गृह मंत्रालय द्वारा दिल्ली नगर निगम अधिनियम, 1957 की चौदहवीं अनुसूची में संशोधन करते हुए दिल्ली नगर निगम के जोनों के नामों को राजस्व जिलों के अनुरूप एकरूप किया गया है। इससे विभिन्न विभाग एक ही क्षेत्र की पहचान एक ही नाम से करेंगे। परिणामस्वरूप विभागों के बीच बेहतर समन्वय स्थापित होगा, योजनाओं के क्रियान्वयन में गति आएगी और नागरिकों तक सरकारी सेवाएं अधिक सरल, तेज तथा प्रभावी ढंग से पहुंच सकेंगी। एक समान प्रशासनिक नामकरण के माध्यम से सुशासन को और सशक्त बनाने तथा जनसुविधाओं को बेहतर करने की दिशा में यह एक महत्वपूर्ण कदम है।

A 29-year-old volunteer died of heart failure after exhausting himself while delivering emergency supplies to #flood-hit communities in South China's #Guangxi Zhuang autonomous region, local media reported. Dang Xinrui, a railway operations controller from Sichuan province, had been on annual leave for a trip to Yunnan province when he learned that volunteers were urgently needed in Guangxi. He immediately changed his plans, traveled to Nanning and joined a relief team. Early July flooding, triggered by Typhoon Maysak, left villages in Hengzhou cut off after roads and bridges were washed away. Before dawn on July 14, Dang and his teammates set out, each carrying about 15 kilograms of medicines, vegetables and other essential supplies. After a six-hour trek along muddy mountain paths, they reached Jiucun of Heyuan village, where residents stranded by floodwaters finally received the much-needed aid. After only a brief rest, the group began the return journey. Dang later complained of dizziness before collapsing. His teammates immediately performed CPR while waiting for medical help. Flood-damaged roads forced medical workers to carry emergency equipment on foot to reach him. Despite more than three hours of resuscitation efforts, Dang could not be revived. #EverydayHero

Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, today, launched the Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based Prime Minister Office System (PMOS), describing it as a transformative digital platform that will modernise governance by recording, communicating, monitoring and tracking every directive issued by the Prime Minister from issuance through implementation, verified completion and post-completion monitoring. Addressing the launch ceremony at the Prime Minister's Office, the prime minister directed all relevant authorities to ensure the immediate and full implementation of the new AI-based system, making it clear that traditional paper-based working would be replaced by digital processes. "From today onwards, I will not expect any of you with a file in your hands. Everything will be discussed through this mechanism," the prime minister said. He praised Minister for Information Technology and Telecommunication Shaza Fatima Khawaja and Secretary IT for their efforts in developing and operationalising the system. He urged all ministries and government departments to adopt the platform, saying it would significantly improve the government's ability to deliver results. "This would make service delivery easier," he remarked. The ceremony was attended by Minister for Economic Affairs Ahad Khan Cheema, Minister for Information Technology Shaza Fatima Khawaja, and other senior officials. During the ceremony, the prime minister was given a comprehensive briefing on the AI-powered platform and its objectives. The prime minister was informed that PMOS was the first government platform in Pakistan to integrate artificial intelligence as a central component of decision-making and implementation monitoring, calling it a trailblazer for the digital transformation of the federal government. According to the briefing, PMOS had been developed at the centre of government to ensure efficient communication of the prime minister's directives throughout the government machinery while enabling timely implementation in accordance with defined quality standards. The system also serves as a secure technology-driven decision-support platform by integrating analytics and structured information within a protected IT environment. During the briefing, it was informed that PMOS would facilitate continuous policy calibration by enabling the government to utilise technological, human and financial resources more effectively to generate better economic outcomes. By introducing the platform at the Prime Minister's Office, the government intends to embed governance reforms at the highest level before extending them across the wider administrative structure. At the heart of the platform is a comprehensive digital repository that records every directive issued by the prime minister together with the complete chain of implementation, making PMOS both an institutional knowledge base and a permanent record of government decision-making. Unlike conventional government tracking systems, the briefing explained, PMOS incorporates an artificial intelligence layer capable of reading, classifying and analysing directives rather than merely storing them. ২০২৬ বিশ্বকাপের ফাইনালে দুর্দান্ত খেলতে থাকা স্পেনের বিপক্ষে আর্জেন্টিনার পক্ষে বলতে গেলে একাই লড়েছেন এমিলিয়ানো মার্টিনেজ। দুর্দান্ত সব রিফ্লেক্স সেভ করে দলকে বাঁচানোর সর্বোচ্চ চেষ্টা করেছিলেন, কিন্তু অতিরিক্ত সময়ে ফেরান তোরেসের গোল ঠেকাতে পারেননি। ম্যাচের পর সামাজিক মাধ্যমে দেওয়া বার্তায় তিনি কাউকে দোষারোপ করেননি; বরং টানা দ্বিতীয়বার বিশ্বকাপ জয়ের স্বপ্ন ভেঙে যাওয়ার বেদনা প্রকাশ করেছেন। সেই সঙ্গে আর্জেন্টিনা জাতীয় দলে তার ভবিষ্যৎ নিয়ে এমন একটি প্রশ্ন তুলেছেন, যা কেউই আশা করেনি। কঠিন এই পরাজয় মেনে নিতে মার্টিনেজের কয়েক ঘণ্টা সময় লেগেছিল। পরে মঙ্গলবার (২১ জুলাই) বুয়েনস আইরেসে ফিরেন তিনি, যেখানে সন্ধ্যার প্রবল ঠান্ডা ও বৃষ্টি উপেক্ষা করে অসংখ্য সমর্থক তাকে স্বাগত জানান। তিনি ইনস্টাগ্রামে হৃদয়বিদারক এক বার্তায় লিখেছেন, 'আমি স্বপ্ন দেখেছিলাম আমরা আবারও বিশ্বকাপ জিতব। স্বপ্ন দেখেছিলাম ট্রফিটা আবার আর্জেন্টিনায় নিয়ে যাব এবং নতুন ইতিহাস গড়ব।' এরপরই তিনি এমন একটি মন্তব্য করেন, যা আর্জেন্টাইনদের বিস্ময়ে বিহ্বল করেছে। দ্রুত ঘুরে দাঁড়িয়ে আবার জাতীয় দলের হয়ে প্রতিশোধ নেওয়ার কথা না বলে তিনি নিজের ভবিষ্যৎ নিয়েই অনিশ্চয়তার ইঙ্গিত দেন। মার্টিনেজ লিখেছেন, 'সত্যি বলতে, এই কষ্ট ভাষায় প্রকাশ করা কঠিন। অনেক কিছু নিয়ে ভাবতে হবে, সামনে কীভাবে এগোব তা নিয়ে সিদ্ধান্ত নিতে হবে। হয়তো এখন সময় এসেছে সরে দাঁড়ানোর।' সংক্ষিপ্ত হলেও এই বক্তব্য ছিল অত্যন্ত শক্তিশালী। কারণ ২০২১ সালের ৩ জুন চিলির বিপক্ষে বিশ্বকাপ বাছাইপর্বের ম্যাচে অভিষেকের পর থেকেই এমি মার্টিনেজ নিজেকে শুধু একজন অসাধারণ গোলরক্ষক হিসেবেই নয়, বরং দলের অন্যতম নেতা হিসেবেও প্রতিষ্ঠিত করেছেন। লিওনেল মেসিসহ সতীর্থদের কাছে তিনি একজন স্বাভাবিক অনুপ্রেরণাদাতা এবং দলের ইতিবাচক পরিবেশ গড়ে তোলার অন্যতম প্রধান কারিগর। নিজের পোস্টের শেষ দিকে, যেখানে রানার্স-আপ পদকে চুমু খাওয়া থেকে শুরু করে বিশ্বকাপ শিরোপা খুইয়ে অঝোরে কাঁদার ছবিও ছিল, মার দেল প্লাতার এই গোলরক্ষক সমর্থকদের কাছে ক্ষমা চেয়ে লেখেন, 'আমি সত্যিই দুঃখিত। আমার দেশ এবং আমার সতীর্থদের সাহায্য করার জন্য আমি সর্বোচ্চ চেষ্টা করেছি।' জর্ডানের বিপক্ষে গ্রুপ পর্বে মাত্র একটি গোল হজম করার পর নকআউট পর্বে নিজের নামের প্রতি সুবিচার করতে ব্যর্থ হন মার্টিনেজ। পরের তিন ম্যাচে (কেপ ভার্দের বিপক্ষে দুটি, মিশরের বিপক্ষে দুটি এবং সুইজারল্যান্ডের বিপক্ষে একটি) মোট পাঁচ গোল হজম করেন। তবে সেমিফাইনালে ইংল্যান্ডের বিপক্ষে আবারও তিনি প্রমাণ করেন কেন তাকে বিশ্বের অন্যতম সেরা গোলরক্ষক বলা হয়। ফাইনালে তিনি ১১টি সেভ করেন, যার অনেকগুলোই ছিল চোখ ধাঁধানো। ১৯৬৬ সালের পর কোনো গোলরক্ষক এক বিশ্বকাপের ফাইনালে এত বেশি সেভ করতে পারেননি। তিনি ১৯৯৪ বিশ্বকাপে ইতালির জিয়ানলুকা পাগলিউকা এবং ১৯৭৮ বিশ্বকাপে তারই স্বদেশি উবালদো মাতিলদো ফিলোলের ৮ সেভের রেকর্ড ছাড়িয়ে নতুন ইতিহাস গড়েন। পুরো টুর্নামেন্টে মার্টিনেজ মোট ২০টি সেভ করে সর্বোচ্চ সেভের তালিকায় তৃতীয় স্থান অর্জন করেন। তার চেয়ে একটি বেশি (২১) সেভ করেন কুরাসাওয়ের এলয় রুম এবং সর্বোচ্চ ২৮টি সেভ করেন প্যারাগুয়ের অরল্যান্ডো গিল। অ্যাস্টন ভিলার এই গোলরক্ষকই একমাত্র নন যিনি জাতীয় দল থেকে সরে দাঁড়ানোর ইঙ্গিত দিয়েছেন। ফাইনাল হারের কিছুক্ষণ পর সংবাদ সম্মেলনে আবেগাপ্লুত হয়ে আর্জেন্টিনার কোচ লিওনেল স্কালোনিও বলেন, 'আমার ব্যাপারে বলতে গেলে, আমি সভাপতির সঙ্গে কথা বলব। আমি কী করতে চাই, সে বিষয়ে আমার একটা ধারণা আছে। চুক্তির মেয়াদ পূরণ করব, এরপর দেখা যাবে। সত্যি বলতে, আমার কিছু সময় নিয়ে ভাবার প্রয়োজন আছে। জানি না, এর চেয়েও বড় কিছু আমি আর করতে পারব কি না। হয়তো আমাদের বসে কথা বলতে হবে। আমাকে এমন একটি সুযোগ দেওয়ার জন্য আমি সভাপতির কাছে কৃতজ্ঞ।' #FIFAWorldCup2026 #WorldCup #Football #SomoyTV

New Policy Brief | Fiscal Implications of Geopolitical Disruptions for India's Fertiliser Sector For decades, India's fertiliser subsidy regime has shielded farmers from volatility in global fertiliser and energy markets. But by insulating domestic prices from international movements, it also transmits sharp increases in global fertiliser, feedstock, and energy prices straight into higher subsidy expenditure. The disruption of the Strait of Hormuz in late February 2026, the principal maritime corridor for India's imports of urea, DAP, LNG, ammonia, and sulphur has brought this vulnerability into sharp focus. Assessing three scenarios for FY27, Ritika Juneja, Sachchida Nand, Emil Thomas Johny, and Ashok Gulati estimate that the fertiliser subsidy, budgeted at INR 1.71 trillion, could rise to between INR 2.42 and 3.32 trillion, or about 0.6–0.8% of GDP. The brief argues the crisis is less a temporary supply disruption than a stress test of India's fertiliser policy, exposing heavy import dependence, the continued price control of urea, distortions in the Nutrient-Based Subsidy framework, and the absence of strategic reserves. It proposes a reform agenda spanning gradual decontrol of urea through a farmer-centric DBT mechanism, rationalisation of the NBS framework, diversification of import sources and feedstocks, strategic fertiliser reserves, and investment in green ammonia, arguing that fertiliser security must be treated as a strategic national priority. 📰 Media Mention Will making EV batteries in India make cars cheaper? ICRIER Research Associate Ritika Verma tells @bsindia the answer is more complicated. The discussion lies beyond cell manufacturing as India's battery ecosystem remains heavily dependent on imported processed critical minerals such as lithium, cobalt, nickel and graphite. Strengthening upstream capabilities, including critical mineral processing and refining, active battery materials, recycling, and sustained investment in research and development, is equally essential for building a resilient, competitive, and strategically secure battery value chain. With critical mineral supply chains increasingly influenced by geoeconomic and strategic considerations, India's policy focus should extend beyond cell manufacturing to developing resilient upstream capabilities, reducing supply chain risks, and increasing domestic value addition across the battery ecosystem. Росіяни атакували звичайну багатоповерхівку. Горять квартири з першого по сьомий поверх. Усі служби працюють на місцях – залучені рятувальники, медики, – роблять усе, щоб допомогти людям. Росіяни завдали ракетного удару по звичайному парку. Атакували місто також реактивними дронами. Пошкодили чотириповерховий житловий будинок, автомобілі. Двох людей було поранено. В області пошкоджено три звичайних житлових будинки. Важливо, щоб партнери продовжували підтримку України. Ухвалення 21-го санкційного пакета від Євросоюзу потрібне, як і підтримка нашої оборони. Все, що допомагає захищати життя, має реалізовуватися якнайскоріше.

National transformation is never a destination reached once. It is a continuous process of reflection, adaptation and reinvention guided by shared aspirations and an unwavering commitment to a better future. At State House Nairobi, received a report on reflections and proposals on strategic guidelines for Kenya's long-term national transformation beyond Vision 2030. We commend Kisumu Prof Anyang' Nyong'o, who is also the governor of Kisumu, and his team of independent economic scholars for their diligence, intellectual rigour and patriotism in preparing this report. We are encouraged that many of the recommendations resonate with the strategic direction we have already embarked upon, including the establishment of the National Infrastructure Fund, the Sovereign Wealth Fund and other transformative initiatives aimed at accelerating inclusive and sustainable development. The next chapter of Kenya's development cannot be written by Government alone. It will be shaped by the collective wisdom, experience and participation of the Kenyan people. Together, through open dialogue, innovation and shared purpose, we will define a bold and enduring vision that secures greater prosperity, opportunity and dignity for every citizen.

The ‘Peace Ship’, powered by nuclear energy, launched on this day in 1959. Officially known as the NS Savannah, it was the world’s first nuclear-powered merchant ship and second-ever nuclear-powered civilian vessel. Former US President Dwight Eisenhower liked to call it the ‘Peace Ship’, as it was built as part of the 1950s ‘Atoms for Peace’ initiative for demonstrating the potential peaceful uses of nuclear energy. This vast 600-foot (182 meter) long, almost 80-foot (24 meter) wide ship was powered by a pressurized water reactor. It had seven cargo holds and could accommodate 60 passengers in its 30 staterooms, dining hall, swimming pool, library, and even cinema. After six years of carrying passengers and cargo, the Savannah was covert into a freight-only vessel until it was retired in 1971.

Global hunger declined in 2025, demonstrating that improvement is possible, but 645 million people are still hungry & 1 in 3 people cannot afford #HealthyDiets. @FAO's Chief Economist @MaximoTorero explains the main findings of #SOFI2026. Full report: doi.org/10.4060/cd8306en Video

Global hunger declined for a third consecutive year in 2025, according to the 2026 edition of The State of Food Security and Nutrition in the World (#SOFI2026) report. But progress remains fragile and uneven – with food insecurity still highest in rural areas and among women. An estimated 645 million people faced hunger in 2025, while 2.1 billion experienced moderate or severe food insecurity – still above pre-pandemic levels. Healthy diets are becoming more expensive and, despite improvements, affordability varies sharply across regions. In Africa, 66.6% of people could not afford a healthy diet in 2025. “Our task now is to turn the evidence SOFI provides into investment - and to do so through partnership. Together, we can build the value chains, market systems and rural economies that make healthy food affordable for all.” said @IFADPresident Alvaro Lario. Mamy instytucję małżeństwa określoną w art. 18 Konstytucji, a ta ustawa wkracza w obszar zarezerwowany dla przepisów polskiego prawa, konstytucji i kodeksu rodzinnego i opiekuńczego, dając związkom nieformalnym przywileje dotąd przynależne małżeństwu. 💬 Udzielanie wsparcia militarnego Ukrainie, to wspólny interes NATO i Unii Europejskiej, żeby chronić wschodnią flankę i nie mieć u granic Federacji Rosyjskiej. Ukrainę należy wspierać, ale równocześnie wywierać presję dla naszych interesów historycznych i gospodarczych. Musimy jednak oddzielić politykę bieżącą – czyli konieczność wojskowego wspierania Ukrainy w walce z Rosją – od naszej polityki historycznej, gdzie powinniśmy twardo ubiegać się o swoje sprawy. prezydent.pl/kancelaria/akty…

This is something I think prediction market people don't take seriously enough. I've often heard prediction markets called "truth engines", but too often their backers forget that they're not predicting The Thing but a simulacrum of The Thing. A market for temperature was cheated when someone found the actual sensor used to measure the temperature, placed a big bet on HOT, and ran a hair dryer on the sensor to make the it hotter. The market was for the sensor, not the actual weather. There are similar ways to cheat all sorts of markets that aren't being used right now, but will be used if the monetary incentives grow strong enough. Paying trial participants to lie. Paying athletes to change how they play. Paying insiders to insert specific words into speeches. I've been fascinated by the potential of prediction markets for a long time, but I don't think they worry enough about the trust-eroding implications of this kind of thing happening at scale. Matt Holtz 🌐🇺🇸🇺🇦 (@Diplomatt42) Prediction markets would be terrible for clinical trials. There’s not much stopping a large gambler from paying participants to report a few fake serious adverse events and potentially derail an early phase drug. New Policy Brief | One Year of U.S. Tariffs: Shifts in India's Export Patterns FY 2025-26 marked the first full year of India–U.S. trade under the reciprocal tariff regime introduced on April 2, 2025 through Executive Order 14257, the most far-reaching U.S. tariff action in nearly a century. India was initially subjected to a 26% reciprocal tariff under a regime that saw several revisions over the year, measures made all the more consequential by India's overdependence on the U.S. market for its exports. With full-year trade data now released by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, @NishaTaneja20, Sanjana Joshi, Vasudha Upreti, Pratik Tiwary, and Yashika Khatri trace the evolution of the tariff measures, assess India's dependence on the U.S. market, examine how exports performed across markets, and evaluate the extent to which affected exports were absorbed elsewhere. Their brief reviews the Government of India's response, from longstanding diversification policies to the renewed push that followed the tariff episode, and sets out recommendations to deepen market diversification and strengthen resilience against market-specific policy shocks. Nineteen years ago, Suvendu Adhikari led the resistance at Singur and Nandigram that stopped the Tata Nano. It broke 34 years of Communist rule, and made forced land acquisition politically radioactive in West Bengal. The same man has become Chief Minister, beating Mamata Banerjee in her own seat. And now he has announced a land policy for industry that is, quietly, almost identical to the one Mamata's government adopted in 2014, and to what the Left Front reached for after Nandigram. Three governments, three bitter rivals, have all come up with the same answer — buy land only from willing sellers, never seize it. Here is the trap. - That approach works well for factory expansions and reviving closed plants. - It falls apart the moment Bengal wants a genuinely large greenfield project, the 1,000-acre kind that would actually shift the state's share of Indian industry. And the reason it falls apart is buried in something the Left Front itself did in the 1980s, which still shapes who can sell land in Bengal today. Every state Bengal is trying to imitate solved this years ago, with an institution that Bengal never built. Adhikari has not said how he will build it now, or where the money would come from with the state this deep in debt. This piece by @bingaspeaks traces why every Bengal land policy since Singur has really been a policy about Singur, and whether Adhikari can be the one to break the pattern. swarajyamag.com/west-bengal/…

1/5: Can India qualify for the FIFA World Cup in 2034? The answer is probably not. And it would be unwise to present it as a promise. The honest thing to do would be to treat 2034 as a national deadline to build a football system capable of mounting a credible World Cup challenge. 2/5: India remains far from the standards required to qualify from Asia. Our national team lacks consistency, and our development system does not produce footballers capable of competing at the highest level. These realities should be acknowledged without defensiveness. So what does it need to do? 3/5: The real focus must be the Indian player. The footballers who could take India to 2034 are between 12 and 20 years old today. We need transparent district-level scouting, quality academies, youth leagues, better coaches, sports science, and regular exposure to stronger opposition. 4/5: No single institution can deliver this. The AIFF, clubs, central and state governments, schools, universities, corporates, broadcasters, the Armed Forces and former players all have a role. This has to become a national football compact with clear responsibilities and measurable outcomes, not a collection of disconnected schemes. 5/5: A credible 2034 World Cup challenge begins with an honest assessment of where Indian football stands today and what can be built. #WATCH | Delhi: On Sonam Wangchuk's health update, Dr. Prof. Manisha Thakur, HOD Medicine, Safdarjung Hospital, says, "He is still receiving medical treatment at VMMC and Safdarjung Hospital of Delhi under the supervision of a multi-disciplinary team which includes experts of AIIMS Delhi and Safdarjung Hospital. At present, his vitals are stable. However, his blood sugar level continuously remains on the lower side. We sent his blood sample yesterday night for his electrolytes, and his potassium was found to be 3.2 mEq per litre. He continues to have persistent pancytopenia that is characterised by anaemia, meaning his haemoglobin is low and he has a low leukocyte count. These clinical and lab parameters warrant continued close monitoring through serial investigations. He is currently receiving oral rehydration therapy, and he is taking oral potassium supplements in the form of a syrup, but he is still continuously declining to get the intravenous therapy and any kind of glucose administration to him. In view of this ongoing mild to moderate dehydration, which he is having persistent laboratory abnormalities and the physiological stress which is associated with the prolonged fasting, he requires sustained medical supervision and continuous clinical monitoring. It is essential for his recovery and for the timely identification of any complication. All the necessary medical care is being provided by the multidisciplinary team in Safdarjung Hospital, and his clinical condition remains under close observation..." Video

Today's Ramsar Spotlight takes us to Bhitarkanika Mangroves in Odisha. The name Bhitarkanika comes from the Odia words 'Bhitar' (interior) and 'Kanika' (extraordinarily beautiful). Once the private residence and hunting grounds of the kings of the erstwhile Kingdom of Kanika, the region is also remembered through the legend of 'Kalia', a colossal saltwater crocodile said to have ruled the Dhamra River for nearly a century. Today, Bhitarkanika continues to preserve Odisha's rich cultural heritage through its historic temples and traditional Nalia grass crafts. #WetlandsofIndia

هادیه در ۱۳ سالگی وادار به ازدواج شد. چهار سال پس از ازدواج باردار شد، اما جنین‌اش در رحم از بین رفت. ۱۸ ماه قبل بار دیگر باردار شد و این بار کودکش به دنیا آمد. اکنون کودک او به سوءتغذیه شدید مبتلا است. هادیه با شوهر ۲۸ ساله‌اش در ولسوالی دورافتاده‌ی «اتغر» ولایت زابل، در جنوب کشور و هم‌مرز با پاکستان، زندگی می‌کند. در روستای محل زندگی آنان نه پرستار زن وجود دارد و نه قابله. هادیه در صحبت با روزنامه اطلاعات روز می‌گوید که هنگام بارداری دوم، رحمش زخم برداشت و همین موضوع باعث شد که هنگام تولد فرزندش درد و رنج بسیار زیادی را تحمل کند. زمستان سال گذشته، همسر هادیه او را با یک ریکشای باربری، پس از یک ساعت راه، به یک مرکز درمانی در ولسوالی «اتغر» منتقل کرد؛ مرکزی که امکانات درمانی کافی نداشت. او گفت: «کودک من به سوءتغذیه مبتلا شده است و دو ماه می‌شود که در شفاخانه در دستگاه مراقبت از نوزاد سپری کرده است اما وضعیت او خوب نشده است.» بیشتر بخوانید: etilaatroz.com/257696

Daily Ukraine map thread for Monday 20th July 2026 Russian shelling of Ukrainian positions in western Donetsk indicates further Ukrainian advances around Voskresenka, Piddubne and Myrne. We've considered this area to be contested since 13th June, so this is an evolution of an existing situation rather than a sudden breakthrough. If you're using other maps, these locations may still appear well inside Russian-controlled territory. Don't mistake delayed mapping updates elsewhere for a dramatic overnight change and get overly excited. Ukrainian assault regiments have continued clearing Russian infiltrators from settlements within our blue-controlled areas where Russian flags had previously appeared. During these operations, Ukrainian forces reportedly captured 64 Russian prisoners over a relatively short period around the Ternuvate/Kosivtseve area. Elsewhere, Ukraine remains under severe pressure around Kostyantynivka and west of Siversk, where Russian forces continue to make gains. It is also very plausible that Russian reconnaissance or infiltration teams have already reached Kramatorsk to establish observation posts or liaise with sympathetic local contacts. If so, these would almost certainly be trained personnel attempting to remain concealed rather than conducting obvious propaganda stunts such as flag-raising. Meanwhile, the Crimean interdiction campaign continues to expand. Ukrainian Unmanned Systems have progressively extended strikes to the southernmost chain of electrical substations along Crimea's southern coast. Shipping and ferry assets have again been targeted, with further attacks appearing very likely this evening. Yeysk Air Base on the eastern side of the Sea of Azov was also struck, reportedly disabling at least three radar systems and a Tor-M2 air defence system. Across the occupied territories, Ukrainian long-range strikes against Russian logistics continue to disrupt supply routes, ammunition movement and rear-area infrastructure. The cumulative effect has become increasingly apparent throughout this year and the pace of the campaign continues to increase. You can use our map to compare March of this year, where it first became noticable that this new capability was truly underway, to July where strikes occur very deep indeed and in greater number. While there remains a considerable distance to go before these disruptions can be fully exploited operationally, they are steadily increasing the strain on Russian logistics.

Hundreds of airframes compressed onto a handful of tarmacs, with less time between launch detection and impact than it takes to get them airborne. More planes parked, more hits. Jordan was supposed to be the fallback. Per NYT reporting, 4 Iranian strikes there in a week produced casualties and aircraft losses, including personnel killed at Muwaffaq Salti. Interception rates in the footage look nothing like the official ones. And the retreat carries its own penalty. Pull back to Israel and every tanker now flies a thousand-plus miles to reach Iran's border. More when carrier aircraft are launching from 1,700 miles out in the Arabian Sea. No tankers, no loiter time. No loiter time, no suppressing Iranian air defenses. No suppression, no cheap bombs. And the cruise missile stocks are already thin. Impossible not to laugh. Large sections of Ukrainian society are viciously attacking Syrski right now, demanding that he be sacked, and it looks as though they are winning. The attached screenshot is from an article General Syrski published today to defend himself, and it really goes to the heart of the matter. The criticism leveled at Syrski by the “progressive” Ukrainian milieu can be summed up in a few points: He has the audacity to insist that war is war and not a Silicon Valley startup. He has the audacity to insist that drones are only one part of contemporary warfare and that, besides drones, you also need everything else a modern military requires. He dares to claim that the word “drone” is not a magic formula that solves all your problems. He is forcing people to dig trenches and fight in a real war instead of the high-tech, asymmetrical, digital Palantir war they were promised — in which they emphatically do not have to dig trenches, but can instead enjoy a matcha latte at a café in Kiev while their MacBook wins the war. That’s really it. They blame everything — the immense casualties, the forced conscription, the loss of territory — on Syrski’s personal qualities, as though he were the only thing preventing them from having ChatGPT code a Win the War app. The fact that this level of discourse is treated seriously by so many people is the result of two factors. The first is that it is in the Ukrainian national character to believe in one-off miracles and fantasies that will solve all their problems. This time, it is Fedorov and his vibe-coded slide decks. You just need to do this one thing and then never do anything again — just as ousting Yanukovich supposedly turned Ukraine into Switzerland overnight. You just need to make the bad man go away, and then bussification will disappear because AI drones from America (the place where virtuous people go after they die) will save the day. It is magical thinking in its dumbest form. The second factor is that the Americans themselves believe this too, and they set the agenda in Kiev. The Americans went into Iran believing that all they needed were their Shahed clones, Palantir, and Claude picking targets, and that everything would then magically resolve itself with the complete annihilation of Iran. Modern war is extremely complicated, intellectually taxing, and requires immense effort at every level of industry and knowledge work. There is no magic bullet, and there is no Win the War button. This is an unpleasant fact. One can understand the Americans’ naïveté, since they have not fought in a real modern war, but the Ukrainians who ought to know better———well, during the Russian Civil War, the Ukrainian nationalists under Petliura, right on the cusp of defeat, began spreading the rumor that they had received a secret directed-energy weapon from the French: the deadly “purple ray”, which would allow them to vaporize entire enemy battalions in a heartbeat. ⚓️📰 #USNAVY UPDATE: MSC Ships Provide Logistics Support During RIMPAC 2026 PACIFIC OCEAN — In the bright, blue waters surrounding the Hawaiian Islands, Military Sealift Command (MSC) Combat Logistics Force (CLF) ships are providing the fuel, supplies, and sustainment that keep the world's largest international maritime exercise underway. Fleet replenishment oiler USNS Guadalupe (T-AO 200) and dry cargo/ammunition ship USNS Washington Chambers (T-AKE 11) are supporting Exercise Rim of the Pacific 2026 by delivering aviation fuel, marine diesel fuel, food, equipment, and other supplies to the 36 U.S. and foreign Navy surface ships participating in the exercise. The ships are conducting multiple replenishment-at-sea (RAS) operations nearly every day, allowing participating forces to remain at sea and focused on mission objectives. While RAS operations are routine for MSC's CLF ships, the pace of RIMPAC is anything but routine. Instead of servicing one or two ships in a day, Guadalupe and Washington Chambers often conduct multiple replenishments daily, with ships receiving fuel and cargo simultaneously on both sides. "The ability to refuel and resupply ships at sea is the logistics backbone that keeps the exercise force sustained and ready," said Capt. Aaron Caputo, civil service master of Washington Chambers. "MSC's ability to deliver fuel, cargo, and logistics support allows U.S. and partner nation ships to remain on station and continue operations throughout RIMPAC."
